guards.why: a refused RCON connection has two opposite meanings - the world has closed, or the server has not opened its RCON port yet - and only the container tells them apart. Reading a refusal from a RUNNING container as "exited" is what let a stop signal three booting servers into a kill-revive-boot loop, so exited may only ever be true for a map whose container is gone
